why: Expression cycle 8 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-8.md) lost 6 round-0 points to reviewers who read the rubric two ways or scored what the evidence did not show. (1) F3: n32's reviewer ruled F3 `n/a` because the data holds no target, best or prior period; n29's reviewer, on one tax year with no target or prior year, scored F3 2 for 'no target, prior year or delta pill' (.26). Cycle 7's n24 was `n/a` on one 30-day window. (2) K3: n32's reviewer scored K3 1 from a keyboard frame that had focused a scroll region (`div[role=region]`), where the keys do nothing; the shipped `basalt-ui shot --states keys` on the same build walks the rows and announces each (.58, .62; the lead fixed its own tool after round 0). n29's reviewer took a point because the log showed one host and a second was 'not shown to be reachable' (.32). (3) X5: n29's reviewer asked for mono merchant names and a delta pill (.37); the shipped rule sets mono for times and ids only, and the data held no baseline for a pill.
what: Three rubric sentences that leave one reading, and the shipped reviewer agreeing with them.
owns: the shipped reviewer's text in packages/basalt-ui/agent/** (the design reviewer subagent and its references), through its generator
change: (1) F3 is `n/a` where the data holds no reference: one period, no target, no prior period, no peer to compare with; a part-to-whole's whole is not a baseline. (2) K3 scores the hosts the keyboard log shows; a host the log does not reach is not marked down, and a keyboard frame on a scroll region (a tabbable box that only scrolls) is no evidence of a host's keys. (3) X5 asks for mono only where the shipped rule does (a time or an id), and a delta pill only where the data gives a baseline.
acceptance: rubric.md says when F3 is n/a
rubric.md says K3 scores the logged hosts and that a scroll region is no keyboard evidence
rubric.md ties X5's mono and pill to the shipped rule and the data's baseline
The shipped reviewer's text agrees, or the PR names where none restates them
out_of_scope: Changing an item's weight or adding an item; skill text (v3-expr-8-skill).
proof: make check; the rubric diff quotes the round-0 shots that read two ways (n29 and n32 reviews, cycle 8).
commits: docs: the rubric text; feat: the shipped reviewer text if it changes; package commits separate from non-package ones.
